title: Jesus... I Told Everyone "All Good" From Inside My Car
topic: he texts "all good bro" to the group chat while sitting in his car outside the office, unable to go in

bible.text: Anxiety weighs down the heart of a man, but a good word cheers it up.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I typed "all good bro" to the boys. Then I sat in my car for twenty minutes. 🚗

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your engine was off and your hands were still on the wheel.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone thinks I've got it together.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Which one of them have you let see the real answer?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Pick one. One honest sentence is a start.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: One good word can lift what you've been carrying alone.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who always says "all good". What would you tell one person today? 👇
